spec_pin.rule: the sha256 of the spec text with exactly the one column-0 'oracle manifest sha256:' line AND the one column-0 'corpus sha256:' line removed (each line + terminator). Two single-line pins on one document: this one excludes both so the corpus pin — 0037's rule, inherited verbatim, excluding only its own line — can be re-pinned second over the final oracle line.

repins.what: Re-pinned after the owner's ruling "Drop the cross-spec total from the per-spec block" (one generated sentence in `## Review closure`; no 0038 content moved). Order: this oracle pin from the landed text FIRST (both pin lines excluded), its line written; then the corpus pin over the text carrying the new oracle line; then the corpus line. The last re-pin of this kind.
repins.method: SHA-256 over the spec's UTF-8 bytes with exactly one `oracle manifest sha256: ` line and one `corpus sha256: ` line (each with its terminator) removed (spec_pin.rule)
